rationale: iter-45: GroupNorm group target 8 -> 2 (16 channels/group, closer to LayerNorm). TIMEOUT at 10:15 / 10:00 wall. The wider-group GN has more compute cost per layer (broadcasting + reduction over more channels per group); pushed past the wall. Cannot evaluate quality.
advice_for_others: GroupNorm groups=2 (16 ch/group) at c=32 + 6 blocks + 8 epochs does NOT fit the 10-min wall on Q8000. The default target=8 is the right operating point not just for quality but for compute. Closes the GN-grouping axis at the wall-budget boundary.
